No promotion-grade new job was found. Upwork surfaced a worldwide remote WooCommerce product-listing assignment at $10-30/h for 50-75 products, but it was posted three weeks ago, already has 20-50 proposals, and Dutch copy is preferred. A current Brigada.sk Bratislava reception role pays 6 EUR/h net and requires conversational English; it is below target economics and language fit. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Client last-viewed decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Use marketplace client last-viewed age as a separate activity signal. Down-rank otherwise attractive freelance listings when the client has not viewed them for several days or weeks.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Language preference vs requirement classifier
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Distinguish preferred language from mandatory language in freelance briefs so optional Dutch/German/etc. reduces score without incorrectly hard-rejecting an otherwise executable remote task.

policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
